source_title: BREAKING: Iranian Missiles Strike Two Vessels Near US Ally Oman; Iran's Chilling Warning To Trump - The Times of India
source_excerpt: The Strait of Hormuz is witnessing a fresh maritime security crisis, with two ships hit in back-to-back incidents as tensions escalate across the strategic waterway. UKMTO confirmed that a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile near Oman's coast, triggering a fire aboard the vessel.
